@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+# Rust counter world
+
+A tiny pure Rust world program for `id`'s multiplayer service — the
+F12.8 (#1065) twin of `../roc-counter`, built on the Rust guest SDK in
+`../rust-world`. The host owns the authoritative state; guests send
+`inc`, and every participant sees the returned `count=N` presentation.
+It demonstrates the SDK's screen helper (the same boxed 20x3 screen
+JSON as the Roc program), the `records` export, and snapshot/restore.
+
+## Build
+
+Requires the `wasm32-unknown-unknown` Rust target:
+
+```sh
+rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
+./build.sh        # cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
+```
+
+`build.sh` refreshes the checked-in `counter.wasm`, which the host's
+F12.7 conformance suite (`pkgs/id/src/sandbox.rs`) loads as the
+`rust-counter` fixture — no Rust toolchain is needed to run the suite.
+
+## Run a hosted world
+
+```sh
+id serve --world --world-admin-token "$WORLD_ADMIN" --world-module counter.wasm
+```
+
+The module has no Wasm imports and exports the full Plaza ABI v1
+surface (see `../roc-world/ABI.md`). The remaining F12.8 scope — the
+second SDK (AssemblyScript vs Zig) and the component-model/WIT
+direction — stays open on #1065 as Drew-owned decisions; this example
+covers the Rust SDK slice only.

@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+# Build the Rust counter guest and refresh the checked-in module the
+# host conformance suite loads. Requires the wasm32-unknown-unknown
+# target (rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown).
+set -eu
+cd "$(dirname "$0")"
+cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
+cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rust_counter.wasm counter.wasm
+echo "wrote counter.wasm"

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+# Plaza guest SDK for Rust
+
+The Rust half of F12.8 (#1065): a guest SDK for `wasm32-unknown-unknown`
+with `screen`, `json`, `grid`, `cap` (and `text`) helpers equal to the
+Roc platform libraries in `../roc-world`, plus the export plumbing that
+turns a pure Rust program into an import-free Plaza ABI v1 world
+module (the contract in `../roc-world/ABI.md`).
+
+A guest is a `cdylib` crate that implements `plaza_sdk::World`
+(`init` / `update` / `view`, with optional `layout` / `records` /
+`wants` / `snapshot` / `restore`) and invokes `plaza_sdk::plaza_guest!`
+once. The macro emits all 14 documented `plaza_*` exports with the
+ABI's exact signatures; the model is an opaque pointer the host passes
+back, outputs go through the one shared output slot, and host inputs
+arrive in `plaza_alloc` memory the host frees with `plaza_free`.
+
+`../rust-counter` is the playable example built on this SDK — the Rust
+twin of `../roc-counter`, with the same events, screen, records, and
+snapshot text, and its checked-in module runs in the host's F12.7
+conformance suite (`pkgs/id/src/sandbox.rs`).
+
+## Component model / WIT
+
+F12.8 also asks for a Wasm component-model / WIT evaluation. That
+decision is **not** taken here: it is a Drew-owned direction for #1065
+(recorded on the issue), and this SDK deliberately targets the landed
+ABI v1 module contract so the Rust SDK is usable today. Nothing in the
+SDK's helper APIs depends on the raw module boundary, so a future
+component-model binding can sit under the same `World` trait.
